name: cell-against-reasoning

finding.title: When a block confirms a known transaction, an account backfilled there leaves out outputs past its address window
finding.description: `extend_until_settled` runs only when `is_new`. When a block confirms a transaction the wallet already saw in the mempool, an account that matches it only now is backfilled at line 16 from the match taken before its address window is extended. `mark_used` extends the window afterwards and never matches the transaction again, so an output to an address past the old window is missing from that account's balance until a rescan delivers the block again.

checks: wallet/scanner.py:16 backfills a known transaction with the match taken before the extension
wallet/scanner.py:19 extends the windows only after the records are made

finding.suggestedFix: Run `extend_until_settled` before the loop for a known transaction too, so a backfilled record holds every output the extended window reveals.

diff --git a/wallet/scanner.py b/wallet/scanner.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2222222
--- /dev/null
+++ b/wallet/scanner.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+def apply_block(wallet, block):
+    """Records each transaction of `block` that pays an address of the wallet's accounts.
+
+    A transaction the wallet saw in the mempool is known already. A rescan delivers every
+    block again from the wallet's birth height.
+    """
+    for tx in block.transactions:
+        is_new = tx.txid not in wallet.known
+        matches = wallet.match(tx)
+        if is_new:
+            matches = wallet.extend_until_settled(tx, matches)
+        for account, outputs in matches.items():
+            if is_new:
+                account.record(tx, outputs, height=block.height)
+            elif not account.has(tx.txid):
+                account.backfill(tx, outputs, height=block.height)
+            else:
+                account.confirm(tx.txid, block.height)
+        wallet.mark_used(matches)
+        wallet.known.add(tx.txid)
